task: Review5 #1 and incremental preview API for #2

api.signature: renderStudioPagePreview(source, page, signal, options?: { onPreview?: (preview: StudioPagePreview) => void }): Promise<StudioPagePreview>
api.callback: Publishes an independent URL + inkRatio snapshot for each completed thumbnail, including noncandidates and standalone images, before candidate text/high rendering. It never includes autoOut; the final Promise carries classification or retryable verification error.
api.abort: Abort from or after callback rejects AbortError, never publishes final autoOut, cancels active rendering, and cleans page resources. A late getPage resolution is cleaned too.
api.budgetAndKeepPolicy: Unchanged single whole-operation 3000 ms deadline; confirmation scale >= 2.5 and >= thumbnail scale; any high-resolution ink retains the page.

cleanup.supportedAPI: PDFPageProxy.cleanup(), never document cleanup/destroy and never private cleanup state mutation

cleanup.installedDocs: pdfjs-dist/types/src/display/api.d.ts lines 1519-1526: page cleanup returns boolean success; document cleanup at 1157-1165 warns about active rendering and is not used
